outcome: maternal and neonatal mortality and morbidity
cohort: 48 pregnant patients at risk of premature rupture of membranes at Zagazig University Hospital.
finding: Lactoferrin supplementation may reduce the risk of premature rupture of membranes.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in mode of delivery between the lactoferrin and placebo groups.
followup_time: N/A (although study duration was 6-12 months, unclear if this refers to duration of supplementation or followup after birth)
